title: ID0417581-DC/Si-D/AT-[Y2 / S6 313706372003] Technical error
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
The OCPP Router XF4 loses “Auth Mode”, “User Name” and “Password” The stations run for several months without problems and then go offline. I have now restored the settings via SCB and the stations are online again. However, this can happen again and again. As far as I know, the fault no longer occurs if the settings are imported directly (locally or via SSH) into the router. It would therefore be necessary to configure ALL stations from the client “Linz AG” via SSH in order to avoid such faults. Please contact us if you need the data for this. At the moment all chargers are online and should have the settings in the router

Hi Vaishnavy,
The loss of this data is a known problem with the Teltonika router. Has this been fixed with the new firmware?  If so, we should update all chargers, but I know that there are some problems with the new FW as well. If the new FW is just a hint, I would rather not update. Otherwise, we have to discuss with the customer whether and when we can carry out the updates. We are talking about 20 chargers. If the error occurs again afterwards, it is difficult to explain.
BR
Daniel
